verdict.rationale: Tipping is a fair axis for an in-person card-reader and POS product like SumUp, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions tipping prompts, tip percentages, smart amounts, or custom tips on the Solo reader, Cloud API, Reader SDKs, or Tap to Pay. The pack only covers checkouts, offline transactions, refunds and reader pairing, which do not show the capability.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can configure tipping prompts (percentages, smart amounts, custom tips) collected on the reader or terminal
